text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: In magnificent fashion, Daiwa Scarlet has shown the world that she's the number one Umamusume in the Twinkle Series.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Now, as the crucial first three years of her career come to a close, the next step in her journey begins.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: Has it been three years already? I'm not sure I know how to feel.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: What about you? How does it feel to have stood side by side with the top Umamusume?

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: It was the same for me.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: I may as well be honest, so… here goes.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: I outran the competition… thanks to you. I was able to become number one—because you were there for me.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: I guess… What I'm saying is…

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: What am I saying? C'mon, snap out of it! All this sentimental stuff isn't like me at all!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: Y-you should be getting back to work, right?! After tomorrow, your schedule's not gonna know what hit it!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: Right! I'm off! See you later, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: …And thank you. I'm so glad I picked you as my trainer.
